name: LargerMaps
author: Luca
description: Selectable 64/72/80/88/96 tactical maps with verified native pathfinding and mission-bounds patches (MENACE 0.7.15 and 0.7.16). Optional terrain stamp density on enlarged maps. Jiangyu port of the legacy Larger Maps modpack; options live in the MenaceModSettings window (F9).
